# <:rules:1246466916927934586> Transpeak Rules
As a member of Discord, you agree to their [Terms of Service](<https://discord.com/terms>) and [Community Guidelines](<https://discord.com/guidelines>).

By joining Transpeak, you also agree to our rules. Please note that staff may address behaviors not listed here in order to maintain a safe and respectful community environment.
### Be considerate of other people
Don’t harass, fight, make fun of, or spoil media for other people. Be respectful of other people’s boundaries; if someone asks you to change the subject or avoid using specific language for them, listen.
### Do not incite arguments, stir the pot, or continue arguments that have been stopped
Avoid discussing religion, politics, and controversial topics except with mod approval in `#set-topic` or `#set-topic-serious`. If an argument starts, contact staff and step away; don’t try to get the last word in.
### Do not post selfies outside of `#selfies`, `#passing-advice`, `#general-over18-sfw`, `#cosmetics` and `#fashion`
For safety reasons, we ask members to not post selfies outside of these four channels as they are locked behind verification, making it more difficult for trolls to steal and use users' selfies for malicious purposes.
### Keep the chat accessible for everyone
Avoid disrupting chat by sending too many messages (aka spam). We love memes, but please be mindful of ongoing conversations and the purpose of each channel. Other examples of disruptive posting include misusing spoiler tags and bots, as well as roleplay and flirting.

Messages and display names must be easily readable, out of consideration for users with reading disorders or users with screen reading software. Names spelled with non-standard symbols or fonts must add a translated or converted version.

>  𝓐𝓵𝓮𝔁 (Alex)

This rule does not apply on nitro fonts, since they are a native Discord feature.

Do not use fast-moving or flashing emojis, stickers, gifs, videos, or avatars, out of consideration for people who experience photosensitivity issues, including those with photosensitive epilepsy, or have other seizure disorders.

Websites, embedded media (e.g., YouTube videos, Tenor gifs), and uploaded content with fast-moving elements must be placed behind spoiler tags and include a content warning. (FAQ: ["How do I spoiler tag my message?"](<https://discord.com/channels/117664143837888519/961734773502537809/1138557638834126909>))

> CW: Photosensitivity warning. Music video with strobe lights. ||https:/​/youtube.com/...||
### Keep all commonly triggering content in the Support category
Extended conversations about commonly triggering topics, including self harm, suicide, emotional/physical/sexual abuse, recreational drug usage (including weed), extreme injury or death, eating disorders and descriptions of discrimination should be contained to the Support category. This list is not all-inclusive; be respectful of other people's requests if they ask for a specific subject or phrase to be avoided.

Brief mentions of commonly triggering content is however allowed, provided that they are labeled and put inside spoiler tags. This also applies to `#positivity`, and to any celebrations of recovery people would like to share there.
### Commonly hateful terms and slurs are not allowed
This includes words like CW ||slurs|| ||trap, tranny, retard, ree||, etc. Slurs may be used in support/venting channels only if venting about the terms being used against people. The f slur (||fag, faggot||) may be used for reclamation for yourself, but never for somebody else.
### Do not misgender or invalidate other people
Do not erase people’s identities or experiences. Check pronoun and identity roles before using gender-coded language for anyone. Avoid using gender-coded language when referring to everyone as a group. More info: <https://discord.com/channels/117664143837888519/961734773502537809/1138443608740085821>

Discussion of transmed/truscum beliefs is under no circumstances welcome on the server. You do not need dysphoria to be trans, and claiming otherwise is not allowed. This extends to discussion and advocacy of prominent truscum figures.
### Do not engage in hateful conduct or spread harmful ideologies
Hateful conduct is defined by the promotion or spread of transphobia, homophobia, sexism, misogyny, misandry, ableism, xenophobia, and racism, among other forms of discrimination.

Harmful ideologies, such as extremist or radical beliefs, can lead to and promote discrimination and harassment on the basis of gender, race, disability, age, etc.

Transpeak provides a safe space for all transgender and gender-nonconforming individuals. Advocating for these harmful acts and ideologies, as well as using associated language (slurs, terms, etc), is prohibited.
### Use the appropriate channels for different conversation topics
Food goes in `#food`, memes go in `#random`, etc. Check channel descriptions for channel-specific rules.
### Keep conversation in English
Our staff primarily speak English, so we ask that chat is kept to English only.
### Do not advertise through Transpeak
This includes surveys, merchandise, other Discord servers, and crowdfunding. Your creative projects, including commissions, may be promoted in `#creativity`; gaming streams can be posted in `#gaming`. Please contact an admin for approval if you would like to post a crowdfunding link.
### Age regression under the age of 13 is not allowed
All participants on Transpeak must be at least 13 years old, including alters, headmates, and those regressed to under 13.
### Discussions around controversial figures are not allowed
Refrain from discussing figures who have expressed homophobia, racism, transphobia or other hatred towards minorities and/or protected groups. This includes but is not limited to discussions about J.K Rowling and Kanye West.
### Do not post material generated by artificial intelligence (AI)
This includes, but is not limited to, AI-generated images, audio and text. Do not promote the use of generative AI, and don't start arguments or debates on the topic. Mentions of the topic are allowed, but prolonged discussions may be approved in ⁠set-topic-serious upon request.
### ⚠️ Staff reserve the right to warn and ban for reasons not explicitly listed here
Please follow the spirit of our rules, not just the letter. Moderators may make the call to punish users who consistently push our boundaries and cause problems.

For ease of moderation, we request that users have no more than one Discord account on the server at a time. If you'd like to use a different account here, please let a staff member know.

## Safe-for-Work Guidelines
1. Keep jokes and conversations PG-13.
2. Non-prescription hormones (aka "DIY") may be discussed, but only in the context of educating about safe practices. Sharing or discussing distributors, vendors or suppliers, or sending direct links to where to buy DIY HRT is strictly prohibited.
3. Pornographic, erotic, and suggestive profile pictures, usernames, text or media are not allowed.
4. No posting sexually explicit content, including but not limited to text, links, and images. 
5. Do not mention or discuss kinks, even non-sexually.
6. Do not post media that focuses on thighs, or showing a user in lingerie.
7. All nipples must be censored, regardless of gender or body type.

# <:modmail:1140971414296469546> ModMail
We use ModMail to help manage support tickets between members and staff.

If you need to get in touch with staff, you can open a ticket by sending a DM to <@1545091109917819041>. All available staff will be able to see and respond to your DMs sent to the bot. You can learn more about ModMail by typing `=help` in <#413114858029056030>.
# <:staff_alert:1194537271970508920> Reporting
If a member is being disruptive, we have a few available options.
- Apps → Report this Message
  - You can right click (or long press on mobile) a member's message, find the `Apps` menu, and then choose `Report this Message`.
  - This sends us the message's content along with the member's info.
- ModMail Ticket
  - You can use ModMail tickets for reports about voice chat, member profiles, or issues that require screenshots / follow-up.
- `!staffalert [optional text]`
  - You can use this command in a DM with <@1541173397780697178> or any text channel.
  - If used in a text channel, your command will be immediately deleted after it's sent.
  - Mentioning the <@&295418997871214592> role directly is another alternative if you don't mind your alert staying up.

## Disciplinary and De-Escalation Systems
**Timeout** - A private channel that restricts access to main channels. Users may be put in timeout after breaking the rules due to being provoked, crisis situations, inebriation, other scenarios where they have less control over their actions, or upon request. If you find yourself in such a situation, please reach out to staff for help.

**Soft Warning** - This is a type of informal warning, and is essentially asking you to stop a specific behavior. If the behavior continues, it may be escalated to a hard warning.

**Hard Warning** - This is a formal warning. Staff will reach out privately to a user, explain which rules they broke, and tell them they are receiving a hard warning. Hard warnings can be given instantly for hostile behavior, or if minor behaviors continue after someone has been told to stop. After someone has been given 1 hard warning, staff may discuss banning them for future infractions, on a case-by-case basis.

**Ban** - A ban removes someone from the server, and will be discussed if someone breaks rules after receiving a hard warning, or for severe problems. All bans are discussed by staff.
Staff discusses all hard warnings and bans individually, and we take context into account when making moderation decisions. For member privacy, we don’t share information about bans or warnings with other people, outside of what is posted to <#1097958530612465704>. If you have a problem with how one of us has handled something, please let us know through our [Anonymous Feedback Form](<https://tally.so/r/wdaYWz>) or by contacting an Admin.

If you need to alert staff of any issues, please use the command `!staffalert [Message about incident]`. This command may be used in any channel, where it will be immediately deleted, or in a DM to our bot, <@1541173397780697178>. If DMing, please include the channel name and a summary of what needs attention so we know what to step in for.

Alternatively, you may simply ping all active staff by mentioning `@staff-alert`.

# <:minecraft_heart:1205181418964258908> Minecraft Server
We host a 24/7 Minecraft server (Java 1.21.8) for Regulars and above.
- Difficulty: Normal
- PVP: On in the Nether only
- Type: Vanilla-like survival with a separate creative world
- Rules: Same as Transpeak, plus no griefing or stealing
### How to Join
1. Be verified (`!v` in <#413114858029056030>)
2. Connect to `mc.transpeak.org` in Minecraft
3. When it asks to enter a code, send a DM to <@1200698054047699045>

## 🔊  Voice Chat Guidelines
Our rules apply to both text and voice chat. Here are some additional guidelines that are specific to our voice channels.
### Respect all speakers
Avoid talking over other people by allowing them to finish their sentences. Do not gender anyone based on their voice. Check or ask about someone's identity and pronouns before using gendered language towards them.
### Do not participate while intoxicated
To maintain a respectful and comfortable environment for all members, those who are drunk or under the influence of drugs are not permitted to join voice channels.
### Report rule-breaking or suspicious activity
Due to the nature of voice channels, staff may not always be present to oversee activity. We ask that members use our [reporting tools](<https://discord.com/channels/117664143837888519/1179263124948385913/1237507506964660426>) if someone is being disruptive.
### Streaming
We may give streaming permissions to Regulars upon request in <#606550086360760340>. To ensure member safety, we ask that members only share content on their screen, such as a game or drawing program. Due to Discord Terms of Service and copyright laws, streaming movies and television is prohibited.
